entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_2} {E : Type u_3} [inst : LinearOrder ι] [inst_1 : OrderBot ι] {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} [inst_2 : NormedAddCommGroup E] [mE : MeasurableSpace E] [inst_3 : NormedSpace ℝ E] [inst_4 : BorelSpace E] [inst_5 : SecondCountableTopology E] {𝓕 : MeasureTheory.Filtration ι mΩ} {F : Type u_4} [inst_6 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_7 : NormedSpace ℝ F] {G : Type u_5} [inst_8 : NormedAddCommGroup G] [inst_9 : NormedSpace ℝ G] (S : ProbabilityTheory.ElementaryPredictableSet 𝓕) (e : E) (B : E →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] G) (X : ι → Ω → F) (i : ι) (ω : Ω), ProbabilityTheory.SimpleProcess.integral B (S.indicator e) X i ω = ∑ p ∈ S.I, (S.set p).indicator (fun ω => (B e) (MeasureTheory.stoppedProcess X (fun x => ↑i) p.2 ω - MeasureTheory.stoppedProcess X (fun x => ↑i) p.1 ω)) ω

entries.name: ProbabilityTheory.HasGaussianLaw.charFun_map_real
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {X : Ω → ℝ}, ProbabilityTheory.HasGaussianLaw X P → ∀ (t : ℝ), MeasureTheory.charFun (MeasureTheory.Measure.map X P) t = Complex.exp ((↑t * ∫ (x : Ω), ↑(X x) ∂P) * Complex.I - ↑t ^ 2 * ↑(ProbabilityTheory.variance X P) / 2)

entries.name: ProbabilityTheory.HasGaussianLaw.charFun_toLp_pi
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst : Fintype ι] {X : ι → Ω → ℝ}, ProbabilityTheory.HasGaussianLaw (fun ω x => X x ω) P → ∀ (ξ : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), MeasureTheory.charFun (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun ω => WithLp.toLp 2 fun x => X x ω) P) ξ = Complex.exp (∑ i, (↑(ξ.ofLp i) * ∫ (x : Ω), ↑(X i x) ∂P) * Complex.I - ∑ i, ∑ j, ↑(ξ.ofLp i) * ↑(ξ.ofLp j) * (↑(ProbabilityTheory.covariance (X i) (X j) P) / 2))

entries.name: ProbabilityTheory.HasGaussianLaw.charFun_toLp_prodMk
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {X Y : Ω → ℝ}, ProbabilityTheory.HasGaussianLaw (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω)) P → ∀ (ξ : WithLp 2 (ℝ × ℝ)), MeasureTheory.charFun (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun ω => WithLp.toLp 2 (X ω, Y ω)) P) ξ = Complex.exp ((↑ξ.fst * ∫ (x : Ω), ↑(X x) ∂P + ↑ξ.snd * ∫ (x : Ω), ↑(Y x) ∂P) * Complex.I - (↑ξ.fst ^ 2 * ↑(ProbabilityTheory.variance X P) + 2 * ↑ξ.fst * ↑ξ.snd * ↑(ProbabilityTheory.covariance X Y P) + ↑ξ.snd ^ 2 * ↑(ProbabilityTheory.variance Y P)) / 2)
